reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to weReci again
reauth_confirm.description: weReci needs you to sign in again — either the sign-in expired, or a new feature needs a permission this connection doesn't have yet (scaling and swaps on the cook display).

abort.already_configured: This weReci account is already connected.
abort.cannot_connect: weReci could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
abort.registration_refused: weReci could not register this Home Assistant. It must be reachable over https, or have My Home Assistant enabled.
abort.no_account: weReci signed you in but did not say which account. Try again.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same weReci account this entry was set up with.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out opening the weReci sign-in page.
abort.missing_configuration: weReci sign-in is not set up. Try adding the integration again.
abort.oauth_error: weReci returned an invalid sign-in response.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out finishing the weReci sign-in.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: weReci did not authorize this connection.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: You declined the connection in weReci.

create_entry.default: Connected. To use the recipe tools by voice or chat: Settings → Voice assistants → your assistant → the gear next to Conversation agent → under Control Home Assistant, tick weReci. The shopping list entity shows the list you share in weReci.

data_description.shopping_list: Your synced weReci list as a to-do list entity.
data_description.control_panel: The weReci dashboard in the sidebar: start a cook, step through it, see the screen. Off hides it; cook displays keep working.

show_cook_display.name: Show cook display
show_cook_display.description: Put weReci Cook Mode's display on a screen and send the pairing link to your phone. The phone drives it.

entity_id.name: Media player
entity_id.description: A Cast device (Nest Hub, Chromecast), Android TV or Fire TV.

browser_id.name: Browser ID
browser_id.description: A browser_mod browser, e.g. a wall tablet. Use instead of a media player.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Notify services to send the pairing link to. Default: every mobile app.

dashboard_path.name: Dashboard path
dashboard_path.description: Only if you built your own dashboard for the display. Default: the one weReci provides.

view_path.name: View path
view_path.description: Only with your own dashboard: the view holding the webpage card.

return_path.name: Return path
return_path.description: Where a browser_mod browser goes when the display stops.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which weReci account, if more than one is set up.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: A recipe to open, by name. It must resemble the recipe's title (see Allow closest match).

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: A recipe to open, by its weReci id (as the recipe tools return it). Use instead of a name.

without_phone.name: Without a phone
without_phone.description: Home Assistant runs the cook itself: no phone, no notification. Needs a recipe. Scaling and swaps work from the screen (they use your weReci AI allowance); Break it down is offered when the recipe was already broken down in the app.

allow_closest.name: Allow closest match
allow_closest.description: weReci's search always finds the nearest recipe, even when nothing fits. Off (default): a name must resemble the recipe's title or the action refuses. On: cook the closest match anyway.

stop_cook_display.name: Stop cook display
stop_cook_display.description: Close the cook display and give the screen back.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which weReci account, if more than one is set up.

toggle_ingredient.name: Tick ingredient
toggle_ingredient.description: Tick or untick one ingredient on the cook display.

index.name: Index
index.description: Position in the sensor's ingredients list, starting at 0.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which weReci account, if more than one is set up.
